title: Framework for an AI-Ready ARPES Community Database
abstract: arXiv:2610.15236v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Condensed matter stands to gain profoundly from widespread adoption of artificial intelligence (AI). However, its current means of data organization impedes this endeavor. As a premier measure of electronic structure underlying material properties, Angle-Resolved Photoemission Spectroscopy (ARPES) has accumulated over four decades of spectra, yet the community's publication-centered workflow preserves only a highly selected fraction of its experimental record. A shared data ecosystem could transform these fragmented measurements and their contexts into a persistent, collective scientific memory, creating immediate value for reproducibility and reuse while laying the foundation for AI-enabled discovery. In this Perspective, we report outcomes of a recent community workshop and propose a practical path toward such an ecosystem. Its benefits unfold along three timescales. translated_title: 面向人工智能就绪的ARPES社区数据库框架
translated_abstract: 凝聚态物质领域有望从人工智能（AI）的广泛应用中获益匪浅，然而其当前的数据组织方式阻碍了这一进程。作为材料性质背后电子结构的首要测量手段，角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）已经积累了四十余年的光谱数据，但该社区以发表论文为中心的工作流程仅保存了实验记录中经过高度筛选的一小部分。一个共享的数据生态系统可以将这些碎片化的测量数据及其背景信息转化为持久的、集体性的科学记忆，为可重复性和数据复用创造即时价值，同时为AI驱动的科学发现奠定基础。在这篇展望文章中，我们报告了近期一次社区研讨会的成果，并提出了构建这样一个生态系统的可行路径。其效益将在三个时间尺度上逐步显现。在短期内，标准化、可检索且可引用的数据集……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文基于社区研讨会成果，提出了构建一个AI就绪的ARPES共享数据生态系统的实用框架，旨在将四十余年来碎片化的实验光谱数据转化为可持续、可复用、可支撑AI科学发现的集体科学记忆。
en_tdlr: Based on outcomes from a community workshop, this paper proposes a practical framework for an AI-ready ARPES shared data ecosystem, transforming over four decades of fragmented experimental spectra into a persistent, reusable collective scientific memory that enables AI-driven discovery.
